name: stn-ultradesign
description: Product-wide UI/UX audits, distinctive design concepts, and faithful implementation across desktop, tablet, and phone.

interface.shortDescription: Audit the product. Refine the concept. Verify the experience.
interface.longDescription: An original design skill connecting visual craft, complete user workflows, accessibility, and frontend engineering. Audit every usage, refine reviewable concepts with the user, and trace approved decisions into verified implementation.
defaultPrompt: Audit the entire frontend and document findings, evidence, and coverage.
Develop a product-specific design concept and refine it with me before implementation.
Implement the approved concept and verify behavior and visual fidelity.
